summary: Multi-agent frameworks expose roles, handoffs and team topologies, while coding products add scoped subagents. Production workforce management still needs cost, permission and outcome controls around those primitives.

items.text: Microsoft AutoGen AgentChat Teams: selector, round-robin, swarm and graph-based teams provide explicit coordination topologies and termination conditions.
Claude Code subagents: named specialists can carry separate prompts, tools, models and permissions for delegated work.
OpenAI Codex subagents: reusable agent roles and parallel delegation provide a coding-specific substrate for a bounded workforce.
CrewAI agents and crews: role, goal, tools, delegation and process configuration model an organization-like agent team.
